annotations.title: Database Schema Migration Differ & Breaking Change Linter

description: Compares source and target DDL schemas to identify breaking changes, destructive column drops, and lock-inducing mutations. Use when verifying CI/CD migration scripts before production deployment to prevent downtime; for verifying relational normal form, use validate_schema_normalization instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'current_schema' and 'target_schema' ('risk_tolerance' defaults to 'zero_downtime_strict'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

current_schema.description: Current production database DDL schema representing live tables and columns.

risk_tolerance.description: Deployment safety policy: zero downtime strict, allow transient locks, or permissive dev.

target_schema.description: Proposed new database DDL schema representing target migration state.

name: detect_breaking_migrations

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for detect_breaking_migrations.

breaking_changes_detected.description: True if breaking changes or destructive table mutations were identified.

breaking_operations.description: List of destructive changes (e.g., column dropped, non-null without default, type narrowing).

migration_steps_safe_order.description: Recommended zero-downtime phased rollout steps (expand, migrate, contract).

risk_level.description: Categorical migration risk assessment (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH_LOCK_RISK, CRITICAL_DATA_LOSS).

title: Database Schema Migration Differ & Breaking Change Linter
